extracted.summary: An opportunity to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds for higher education.
extracted.amount_text: Graduation 1st, 2nd and 3rd year regular courses: INR 12,000 per annum. Graduation 4th and 5th year professional courses: INR 20,000 per annum. Graduation up to 3rd year technical courses: INR 12,000 per annum. Postgraduation all courses: INR 20,000 per annum.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have passed Class 12 from a recognised institution with a minimum score of 80% in their chosen stream.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual parental/family income not exceeding INR 4,50,000.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate (UG) or postgraduate (PG) program in a professional field at a college/institution recognised by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) or other relevant regulatory bodies.
